project_type: Python FastAPI backend (MongoDB via Motor) + Next.js 14 TypeScript frontend (App Router)
build_system: Backend: no build step — pytest directly. Frontend: npm with Next.js App Router under frontend/. Import alias '@/' maps to 'frontend/src/' (see tsconfig). API client lives at frontend/lib/api.ts (not src/).
test_framework: Backend: pytest (plain asyncio.new_event_loop pattern — no pytest-asyncio, no @pytest.mark.asyncio; see test_m8, test_m10). Frontend: tsc --noEmit + next build (no jest).
verification_instructions: 1. cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -x -q  (all existing tests must still pass). 2. cd frontend && npm run build  (0 TypeScript errors, 0 ESLint errors). 3. git diff --check (no whitespace errors).
environment_constraints: Windows paths. Backend uses MongoDB (Motor/mongomock-motor for tests) — NOT SQLAlchemy/Alembic/PostgreSQL (that was removed in M1). The db/models.py SQLAlchemy file still exists but is NOT used; ignore it. All backend models extend backend.models.base.DocumentModel/TimestampedModel (Pydantic, MongoDB). cryptography package is installed transitively via python-jose[cryptography] — Fernet from cryptography.fernet is available without a new pip install.
contribution_requirements: Preserve all existing M40 functionality and current premium light theme. Do NOT modify backend/api/v1/provider_ops.py. Include new router in backend/api/v1/__init__.py. Use require_platform() for all new admin endpoints. Never return raw API keys to the browser. Audit every config-change action. Update MVP_PROGRESS.md and MVP_TEST_STATUS.md.
key_patterns: Backend models: class Foo(TimestampedModel) with id: str = Field(default_factory=new_id, alias='_id'). Repositories: class FooRepo(BaseRepository) with collection_name and model_class, using self.find_many/insert/update_one. Tests: def run(coro): loop=asyncio.new_event_loop(); return loop.run_until_complete(coro). Credentials: never logged, never returned to browser. Frontend pages: 'use client'; useState + useCallback + useEffect + toast.error(). UI imports from @/components/ui/* (Card, CardBody, CardHeader, Button, Spinner, EmptyState, SimpleTable, TableRow, TableCell, MetricCard, StatusBadge). API calls via api.xxx() from '@/lib/api'. Admin sidebar at frontend/components/layout/admin-sidebar.tsx — add new links to ADMIN_LINKS array.
directory_structure: backend/ — FastAPI app. backend/models/ — Pydantic/MongoDB document models. backend/repositories/ — Motor async DB wrappers. backend/services/ — business logic. backend/api/v1/ — route modules, aggregated in __init__.py. backend/core/ — auth, rbac, db, redis. backend/audio/ — TTS/STT engines. backend/agent/ — LLM client. backend/providers/ — provider abstractions (M8). backend/tests/ — pytest test files. frontend/ — Next.js app. frontend/app/(admin)/admin/ — super admin pages. frontend/components/layout/ — AdminSidebar, Topbar. frontend/components/ui.tsx — shared UI primitives. frontend/lib/api.ts — typed API client. frontend/contexts/auth-context.tsx — JWT auth.
